title: What to do as a family in February | Family Season
description: Three ready plans for February for the whole family: a month about ourselves with meditation and the wheel of life, taking care of ourselves with the barber and the doctor, and a month of helping at the animal shelter. Open one, change it, print it on A4.
label: February
heading: What to do as a family in February
lead: February is the shortest month and the one that drags the longest: winter has outstayed its welcome, the light is not back yet, and there is less strength left for it than for any other month.

So February is no month to start something grand. It is the month for what is close: yourself, your own body, and the people nearby who need hands rather than money. That is what the three plans below are about.
seasonsText: Each one opens in full: the weeks, a project for everybody in the family, the goal of the month. Any of them can be rewritten for you and printed on two A4 sheets.
actionText: If none of them fits, build your own: the theme of the month, four weeks and a project each. It prints the same way — two pages, and onto the fridge.
moreText: Other families put their seasons up too — there are more on the showcase.
